newsitem.title: USA: US spot liquids steady, industry event dulls trade.
newsitem.headline: US spot liquids steady, industry event dulls trade.

text.p: U.S. spot liquids prices were stable in very quiet trade late on Monday amid an industry event that pulled many players away from their desks.
The LPG Marketer's Association was holding a golf tournament in Houston, Texas, attended by many LPG traders.
"It's very dead," said one Houston trader.
Meanwhile, NCRA confirmed Monday its 75,000 barrel per day Mcpherson, Kansas, refinery will shut down April 1 for a month-long turnaround.
Players had said earlier that news of its turnaround pressured prices of natural gasoline down in the Conway, Kansas, hub.
In the U.S. Gulf Coast, Mont Belvieu, Texas, spot propane was steady at 38.00/38.25 cents and Conway material traded at 37.00 cents.
Belvieu butane traded at 44.375 cents, largely steady from midday Monday. ((--Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk 1212 859-1631))
